bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs, document.rs, pasteboard.rs, restoration.rs, workspace.rs, observable.rs, springboard/ui/src/controller.rs, springboard/core/src/occlusion.rs
summary: App lifecycle, documents, pasteboard, state restoration, workspace and sandbox permissions have SDK counterparts. Object and array controllers now hold content, arrangement and selection in the UI kit, and a run-state model separates focus, visibility, occlusion and suspension. Declarative bindings to views, nib/storyboard loading, a general app extension host and iCloud have no equivalent.

features.note: Glass backdrop exists in the shell; no app-facing material API guaranteed
Parity tracked per feature, not per release
Bubblewrap sandbox and file grants; per-app permissions like documents; no permission prompt for every data class
Apple hardware migration; packages are x86_64-linux

features.apple: NSApplication, NSWorkspace, NSRunningApplication, app delegate, process info
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/runtime.rs (App trait, Ctx); springboard/sdk/src/workspace.rs; springboard/sdk/src/process_info.rs; springboard/sdk/src/service_management.rs; springboard/core/src/occlusion.rs (run states)
features.note: Lifecycle, open/reveal/recycle, launch events present. The run-state model (focus, visibility, occlusion, suspension with a grace period) is pure and tested; the shell does not feed it window events yet. Memory-warning callbacks to apps are still planned (task/008-lifecycle-recovery.md)

features.apple: Document model, open/save panels, autosave, versions
features.note: Document model and panels exist; see docs/bifrost-ui.md Documents section for gaps
Shell publishes only one text-like type to Wayland selection; other types stay inside BifrOSt

features.apple: iCloud document storage and key-value sync
features.note: Cloud sync lives in ~/Projects/bifrost-cloud (outside this repo); no SDK API for apps
Reopens windows when logging back in

features.apple: NSObjectController, NSArrayController, NSTreeController, NSDictionaryController, KVC/KVO bindings
features.note: Observable<T> gives value streams. ObjectController and ArrayController hold content, sort descriptors, a filter, the selection by content index, select next/previous, and insert/remove that keeps the selection. Missing: tree and dictionary controllers, key-path binding to views, and rearrangement when an object's sort key changes in place
Apps build UI in Rust code; no declarative UI file format or bundle resource loader found in the SDK

features.apple: Share, Quick Look, widget, Finder-sync and other extension points
features.note: Individual extension-like APIs exist; no general extension host or packaging model

gaps: Declarative key-path bindings from controllers to views; no key-value observation in the SDK
Tree and dictionary controllers (NSTreeController, NSDictionaryController equivalents)
Automatic rearrangement when an object's sort or filter key changes in place
General app extension host and packaging
iCloud-style document and key-value sync API
App memory-warning callbacks; the shell does not send window occlusion events to apps yet (task/008-lifecycle-recovery.md)
Multi-type pasteboard publishing to the Wayland selection
